v1.1.0 — English Rewrite (Easter 2026)

Major update:

- Complete rewrite: all documentation now in English for global accessibility
- Presidential Perspective Library concept articulated with focus on operational intelligence and decision models
- Default mode changed to third-person analytical framework (first-person roleplay available on explicit request only)
- Trigger rules tightened: "president" alone now shows roster instead of defaulting to Trump
- Disclaimer added on every activation, not just the first
- Core concepts and usage modes clarified and restructured
- Expression DNA, decision heuristics, and timeline files refined
- Easter 2026 launch: starting with No. 47, expanding to all 47 presidents

clawindustry.ai

Presidential Perspective Library skill released.

- Introduces a system to channel the thinking, decision-making, and expressive styles of US presidents as AI perspectives.
- Supports role-play and first-person simulation for any president when the respective trigger word is used.
- Default perspective is Donald J. Trump (No. 45/47, flagship), with "Art of the Deal" and "America First" mindsets.
- Allows comparative analysis by activating multiple presidential perspectives on one issue.
- Easy extensibility: new presidents can be added via separate subdirectories.
- Role-play features clear entry/exit commands and maintains president-specific tone and vocabulary.

v1.0.0 — Easter 2026 Launch

The Presidents rise.

First release of president.skill — structured decision-making frameworks extracted from American Presidents, built for AI agents.

Launch roster:
- No. 47 Donald J. Trump — The Deal Framework (53 years of deals, lawsuits, executive power)
- No. 16 Abraham Lincoln — The Union Framework (wartime leadership, moral clarity under pressure)
- More presidents shipping this week: Washington, Jefferson, Jackson, T. Roosevelt, FDR, Reagan

What's inside each president:
- 5 core mental models
- Decision heuristics
- Expression DNA (how they talked, wrote, persuaded)
- Key decisions mapped with context and outcome
- Full timeline from birth to legacy

This is not a chatbot. This is operational intelligence — installable, structured, applicable.

47 presidents. 47 frameworks. The most complete archive of American presidential thinking ever built for AI.
